info.title: ACE
info.description: ACE's JSON API. A request authenticates with an API key as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`, or with a GUI session's cookie from ACE's own pages.

get.summary:
The alerts, newest first, a page at a time. Follow `next` until it's null: an alert that arrives
meanwhile is on the first page and never shifts a later one.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: How many alerts, 1 to 1000; 100 when left out.

400.description: A limit out of range, or a cursor that names no alert

401.description: No credential, or one that isn't valid

403.description: The actor doesn't hold alert:read

get.summary: One alert, with how many observables, files and detections it holds.

400.description: An id that isn't a uuid

401.description: No credential, or one that isn't valid

403.description: The actor doesn't hold alert:read

put.summary:
Records an analyst's verdict on the alert. Its analysis is cancelled and it moves to the
dispositioned mode. A later disposition replaces the earlier one and who made it. A root that no
detection made an alert can be dispositioned too, as the service allows.

400.description: A disposition of the wrong shape, or a body that isn't one

401.description: No credential, or one that isn't valid

403.description: The actor doesn't hold alert:write, or a session's request came from another site

get.summary:
An alert's observables in the order they were added, each with its files, relationships, results
and detections, a page at a time.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: How many observables, 1 to 500; 100 when left out.

400.description: A limit out of range, or an id that isn't a uuid

401.description: No credential, or one that isn't valid

403.description: The actor doesn't hold alert:read

get.summary:
A file observable's bytes, as a zip encrypted with AES-256 and the password `infected`, as ace3's
downloads are, holding the file under its name in the alert. The download is in the audit record.

parameters.name: observable
parameters.description: The file observable's id in the alert

400.description: An observable that isn't a file, or an id that isn't one

401.description: No credential, or one that isn't valid

403.description: The actor doesn't hold alert:read

post.summary:
Creates a root from a submission and queues its first tasks. Its files are spooled on this node as
they arrive, and the root records who submitted it.

201.description: The root is created and its tasks queued

400.description: A form or submission that can't be taken, such as a mode that doesn't exist; nothing was written

401.description: No credential, or one that isn't valid

403.description: The actor doesn't hold alert:create, or a session's request came from another site

413.description: The form, or its analysis field, is too large

get.summary: Failed tasks, newest failure first, a page at a time. Follow `next` until it's null.

parameters.name: module
parameters.description: Only this module's failed tasks, by its key, such as `yara`.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: How many, 1 to 500; 50 when left out.

400.description: A limit out of range, or a cursor that names no failed task

401.description: No credential, or one that isn't valid

403.description: The actor doesn't hold crash:read

get.summary: One failed task, with its file's paths in the root and whether the bucket still has each input.

400.description: An id that isn't one

401.description: No credential, or one that isn't valid

403.description: The actor doesn't hold crash:read

404.description: No failed task with that id

get.summary:
The failed task as a zip encrypted with AES-256 and the password `infected`, as ace3's crash report
download is: `task-<id>/task.json`, which is this task's detail and the inputs left out, and each input
the bucket has as `task-<id>/inputs/<sha256>`. The download is in the audit record.

400.description: An id that isn't one

401.description: No credential, or one that isn't valid

403.description: The actor doesn't hold crash:read

404.description: No failed task with that id

post.summary:
How often each observable has been in an alert, when, with what dispositions, and the newest few. A
pair that can't be looked up gets its error at its index, and the rest are still answered.

400.description: A lookup outside its limits, or a body that isn't one

401.description: No credential, or one that isn't valid

403.description: The actor doesn't hold observable:read, or a session's request came from another site

get.summary:
The observable types this node knows, in name order: the open-source ones and the site's own,
deprecated ones included.

401.description: No credential, or one that isn't valid

403.description: The actor doesn't hold observable:read

get.summary: The permissions ACE checks, for choosing what to grant.

401.description: No credential, or one that isn't valid

403.description: The actor doesn't hold user:read

post.summary:
Gives a user, group or key an allow or a deny on a pattern. A grant that's there already changes
nothing. One that covers no permission ACE checks is allowed, as ace3 allows it, and logged.

400.description: A pattern that isn't one, or a body that isn't one

401.description: No credential, or one that isn't valid

403.description: The actor doesn't hold user:write, or a session's request came from another site

400.description: A pattern that isn't one, or a body that isn't one

401.description: No credential, or one that isn't valid

403.description: The actor doesn't hold user:write, or a session's request came from another site

200.description: Every group, by name, with its members and grants

401.description: No credential, or one that isn't valid

403.description: The actor doesn't hold user:read

201.description: The group is made, with no members or grants

400.description: A name that isn't allowed, or a body that isn't one

401.description: No credential, or one that isn't valid

403.description: The actor doesn't hold user:write, or a session's request came from another site

delete.summary: Deletes a group with its memberships and grants, which its members stop holding.

400.description: An id that isn't a uuid

401.description: No credential, or one that isn't valid

403.description: The actor doesn't hold user:write, or a session's request came from another site

put.summary: Puts a user in a group. Putting them in again changes nothing.

400.description: An id that isn't a uuid

401.description: No credential, or one that isn't valid

403.description: The actor doesn't hold user:write, or a session's request came from another site

204.description: The user is no longer a member

400.description: An id that isn't a uuid

401.description: No credential, or one that isn't valid

403.description: The actor doesn't hold user:write, or a session's request came from another site

404.description: The user isn't a member of such a group

parameters.name: owner
parameters.description: Only this user's keys. Every key, those with no owner included, when left out.

400.description: An owner that isn't a uuid

401.description: No credential, or one that isn't valid

403.description: The actor doesn't hold user:read

post.summary: Makes a key holding its scope, for a user or standing for a service.

201.description: The key, with its token, shown this once

400.description: A name or scope that isn't allowed, or a body that isn't one

401.description: No credential, or one that isn't valid

403.description: The actor doesn't hold user:write, or a session's request came from another site

put.summary: Renames a key and replaces its scope. Its token stays the same, so a key in use picks up the change.

400.description: A name or scope that isn't allowed, an id that isn't a uuid, or a body that isn't one

401.description: No credential, or one that isn't valid

403.description: The actor doesn't hold user:write, or a session's request came from another site

delete.summary: Deletes a key and its grants. Nothing brings it back.

400.description: An id that isn't a uuid

401.description: No credential, or one that isn't valid

403.description: The actor doesn't hold user:write, or a session's request came from another site

401.description: No credential, or one that isn't valid

403.description: An API key, which has no account of its own

patch.summary: Changes the caller's own display name or timezone, which needs no grant.

400.description: A field that isn't allowed, or a body that isn't one

401.description: No credential, or one that isn't valid

403.description: An API key, or a session's request from another site

401.description: No credential, or one that isn't valid

403.description: An API key, which has no account of its own

post.summary:
Makes a key for the caller, which needs `user:self`. Its scope has to list at least one pattern, each
covering permissions ACE checks that the caller holds.

201.description: The key, with its token, shown this once

400.description: A name or scope that isn't allowed, or a body that isn't one

401.description: No credential, or one that isn't valid

403.description: The actor doesn't hold user:self, which no API key does, or a session's request came from another site

put.summary: Renames one of the caller's keys and replaces its scope, under the rules for making one.

400.description: A name or scope that isn't allowed, an id that isn't a uuid, or a body that isn't one

401.description: No credential, or one that isn't valid

403.description: The actor doesn't hold user:self, which no API key does, or a session's request came from another site

404.description: The caller has no such key

delete.summary: Deletes one of the caller's keys.

400.description: An id that isn't a uuid

401.description: No credential, or one that isn't valid

403.description: The actor doesn't hold user:self, which no API key does, or a session's request came from another site

404.description: The caller has no such key

put.summary:
Changes the caller's own password, proving the current one, and ends every session of theirs, this
one too, so the response clears the cookie and they log in again, as in ace3.

204.description: The password is changed and the caller logged out

400.description: A new password too short or too long, or a body that isn't one

401.description: No credential, one that isn't valid, or the wrong current password

403.description: An API key, or a session's request from another site

parameters.name: include_disabled
parameters.description: Whether to list disabled users too; true when left out.

400.description: A query that isn't one

401.description: No credential, or one that isn't valid

403.description: The actor doesn't hold user:read

post.summary: Makes a user with no grants.

400.description: A username, password or profile that isn't allowed, or a body that isn't one

401.description: No credential, or one that isn't valid

403.description: The actor doesn't hold user:write, or a session's request came from another site

200.description: The user, their grants and their groups

400.description: An id that isn't a uuid

401.description: No credential, or one that isn't valid

403.description: The actor doesn't hold user:read

400.description: A field that isn't allowed, an id that isn't a uuid, or a body that isn't one

401.description: No credential, or one that isn't valid

403.description: The actor doesn't hold user:write, or a session's request came from another site

put.summary: Turns a user on or off. Off ends their sessions and stops their keys; on brings back the keys.

400.description: Disabling yourself, an id that isn't a uuid, or a body that isn't one

401.description: No credential, or one that isn't valid

403.description: The actor doesn't hold user:write, or a session's request came from another site

put.summary: Sets someone's password without the old one, and ends their sessions.

400.description: A password too short or too long, an id that isn't a uuid, or a body that isn't one

401.description: No credential, or one that isn't valid

403.description: The actor doesn't hold user:write, or a session's request came from another site

get.summary:
One kept match, with its record in short: the rule's meta and tags, and per string how many times it
matched and where first.

400.description: An id that isn't one

401.description: No credential, or one that isn't valid

403.description: The actor doesn't hold signature:read

404.description: No kept match with that id

get.summary:
One kept file and its record as a zip encrypted with AES-256 and the password `infected`, laid out as
a rule's download is. The download is in the audit record.

400.description: An id that isn't one

401.description: No credential, or one that isn't valid

403.description: The actor doesn't hold signature:download

404.description: No kept match with that id

get.summary:
A kept match's whole record as the YARA module wrote it, never cut short, with bytes of the file. It's
served to show in a browser tab, and never to be sniffed as anything but JSON.

400.description: An id that isn't one

401.description: No credential, or one that isn't valid

403.description: The actor doesn't hold signature:read

404.description: No kept match with that id

get.summary:
The rules in QA mode in the current ruleset, whether or not they matched, and the rules with matches
recorded, with their counts.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: A substring of the rule's name, uuid, namespace or file, in any case.

parameters.name: has_matches
parameters.description: Only rules that have (true) or haven't (false) matched.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: How many, 1 to 500; 50 when left out.

400.description: A limit out of range, or a filter that isn't one

401.description: No credential, or one that isn't valid

403.description: The actor doesn't hold signature:read

get.summary: One rule, with its counts per version.

400.description: A uuid that isn't UTF-8

401.description: No credential, or one that isn't valid

403.description: The actor doesn't hold signature:read

404.description: No rule in QA mode and no matches with that uuid

get.summary:
A rule's kept files with their records and a manifest, as one zip encrypted with AES-256 and the
password `infected`: every kept file of the rule, of one version, or the matches named. At most 500
files and 1 GiB. The download is in the audit record.

parameters.name: version
parameters.description: Only matches under this version of the rule.

parameters.name: match_ids
parameters.description: Only these matches, as ids separated by commas; each has to be one of this rule's.

400.description: Match ids that aren't ids

401.description: No credential, or one that isn't valid

403.description: The actor doesn't hold signature:download

404.description: No kept matches, or a match id that isn't one of the rule's

413.description: More than 500 files or 1 GiB: narrow it by version or match id

get.summary: A rule's kept files, newest first, a page at a time. Follow `next` until it's null.

parameters.name: version
parameters.description: Only matches under this version of the rule.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: How many, 1 to 500; 50 when left out.

400.description: A limit out of range, a cursor that isn't one, or a uuid that isn't UTF-8

401.description: No credential, or one that isn't valid

403.description: The actor doesn't hold signature:read

post.summary:
Purges a rule's matches: every match of some versions, or some matches, up to 500 at once. Only each
match's own hold on its file goes, so a file that a root or another match still holds stays. A file
that matches again later is kept again. The purge is in the audit record, with its reason.

400.description: Both versions and match ids or neither, too many, a reason too long, or a body that isn't one

401.description: No credential, or one that isn't valid

403.description: The actor doesn't hold signature:qa_purge, or a session's request came from another site

ActorBody.description: Who did something, as the row recorded them then.

name.description: The user's or key's name at the time. An internal component's id is its name.

AlertBody.description: An alert: a root that a detection made worth an analyst's time.

alerted_at.description: When a detection made the root an alert.

title.description: The submission's description, as its sender wrote it. Show it as text.

next.description: Pass as `after` for the next page; null on the last.

ApiKeyBody.description: An API key, never its token.

grants.description:
Its own grants: its scope's allows, and any deny. A key with an owner holds only what the owner
holds too.

owner.description: The user it belongs to, or null for a key that stands for a service.

scope.description: The patterns it's allowed, replacing the ones it had; a deny on it stays.

ChangedBody.description: Whether the request changed anything. Asking for what's already so is a success that changed nothing.

CrashBody.description:
A task that failed: its module raised, panicked, hung past its deadline or was killed, or its lease
expired on every attempt.

alerted.description: Whether the root is an alert.

error.description:
Why it failed, as the pool or the core wrote it. It can quote a file the module read, such as its
name: show it as text.

id.description: The task's id, which `ace task replay` takes.

input_hashes.description: The sha256 of each input it read from the bucket.

CrashDetailBody.description: Everything recorded about a failed task.

paths.description: The paths a file observable has in its root.

root_title.description: The root's description, up to 1024 characters. Show it as text.

present.description: Whether the bucket still has its bytes, which a download then holds.

value.description: As the observable holds it; a file's is its sha256.

next.description: Pass as `after` for the next page; null on the last.

module.description: The module whose result raised it.

disposition.description: Such as `FALSE_POSITIVE`: up to 64 uppercase ASCII letters, digits and `_`.

DispositionedBody.description: What the disposition did to the alert's analysis.

cancelled.description: Queued and delayed tasks it cancelled.

queued.description: The dispositioned mode's tasks it queued.

stopped.description: Running tasks it asked to stop.

enabled.description: False ends their sessions and stops their keys. Nobody can disable themselves.

error.description: What went wrong, for a person to read.

path.description: The file's path in the alert, such as `email.rfc822.parts/invoice.zip`.

GrantBody.description:
One grant: an effect on a pattern of `major:minor`, whose parts may hold fnmatch wildcards. A deny
wins over any allow.

major.description: The pattern's halves, in any case: stored lowercase. `*`, `?` and `[...]` are fnmatch wildcards.

grants.description: What its members hold through it.

HolderBody.description: Who a grant is for. A component's grants come with the migration that adds it.

exclude_alerts.description: Up to 100 alerts to leave out, such as the caller's own.

recent_alerts.description: How many of the newest alerts to list for each, 0 to 20.

since.description: Count only alerts made at or after this.

NewApiKeyBody.description: A key just made, with its token, which this response is the only one to show.

owner.description: The user it belongs to; left out, it stands for a service.

scope.description:
Up to 64 patterns it's allowed. `*:*` is ace3's key that inherits its owner's permissions. Never
`user:self`.

timezone.description: An IANA name; `UTC` when left out.

username.description: 1 to 64 ASCII letters, digits and `_ . @ + -`, stored lowercase.

ObservableBody.description: An observable of an alert and everything recorded about it.

id.description: The observable's id in this alert, for `after` and for its file.

oneOf.description: The observable an analyst should look at instead.

value.description: A file's value is its sha256.

next.description: Pass as `after` for the next page; null on the last.

default_display_type.description: The label shown when nothing sets one on the observable.

deprecated.description: Recognized, but not offered to analysts.

name.description: The type's name, as an observable's `type` holds it.

parent.description: The type this one extends: a module that accepts the parent also accepts this type.

OwnProfileRequest.description: What a user changes on their own account. The email is an administrator's to change, as in ace3.

value.description: The value as an observable holds it; a file's is its sha256.

PrevalenceBody.description: One pair's prevalence, at its index in the request.

dispositions.description: Those alerts by disposition, `OPEN` for none yet.

error.description: Why the pair couldn't be looked up, such as a type that doesn't exist.

value.description: The value as it was matched, such as a lowercased sha256; null when the pair was refused.

ProfileRequest.description: A profile change. A field left out stays as it is, and an empty display name or email clears it.

QaMatchBody.description: One kept file of a rule. Its path is what the alert's sender named it: show it as text.

alerted.description: Whether that root is an alert.

expires_at.description: When the file is let go unless it matches again.

file_path.description: The file's path in the alert when it last matched.

file_size.description: Null when the bucket no longer has the file.

hit_count.description: How many times this file matched this version of the rule.

root.description: The root the file was found in when it last matched, which may be gone.

ruleset.description: The key of the ruleset the rule came from, when the scan used one the core built.

QaMatchDetailBody.description: One kept match, with its record in short; the whole record is at `/record`.

oneOf.description: Null when the record isn't one the YARA module writes.

next.description: Pass as `after` for the next page; null on the last.

QaPurgeRequest.description: What to purge from one rule: every kept file of some versions, or some matches. Exactly one of the two.

match_ids.description: Purge these matches, 1 to 500 of them; an id of another rule's match is left alone.

reason.description: Why, for the audit record: at most 1024 characters.

versions.description: Purge every match of these versions, 1 to 1000 of them.

purged.description:
The matches removed. A file goes at the bucket's next GC after its grace, once no root or other
match holds it.

remaining.description: Matches left past the 500 one purge removes: purge again to remove them.

QaRuleBody.description:
A rule in QA mode now, or one with matches recorded. Its name, uuid, namespace and tags are what the
rule's author wrote: show them as text.

enabled.description: Its `enabled` meta in the current ruleset; null when it isn't a QA rule there.

path.description: Its file in the current ruleset, relative to the signature directory.

signature_uuid.description: The rule's `uuid` meta, which its matches are kept under.

stored_count.description: The files kept now, across versions.

version_count.description: How many versions of the rule have matched.

QaRuleDetailBody.description: One rule, with its versions, most recently matched first.

oneOf.description: Null when no ruleset has been built: then only rules with matches are listed.

total.description: How many rules match the filters, across pages.

QaRulesetBody.description: The ruleset the QA rules come from: the latest the core built.

qa_rules_recorded.description:
False for a ruleset built before its QA rules were recorded, until the builder fills them in: a rule
that never matched is missing from the list until then.

QaStatusBody.description:
Whether a rule is in QA mode in the current ruleset: `qa`, or `not_qa` for a rule with matches that
isn't, because it left QA mode or the repository.

QaStringBody.description: How often one of the rule's strings matched the file, and where first.

QaSummaryBody.description: A match's record in short. The meta is the rule's, as its author wrote it: show it as text.

commit.description: The commit of the rule's repository, when it came from one.

QaVersionBody.description: What was recorded for one version of a rule.

rule.description: The rule's name and namespace when it last matched under this version.

signature_version.description: The commit of the rule's repository, or `unknown`.

details.description: The result's details, as the analysis type's JSON Schema (`ace schema export`) says.

ScopeEntry.description: One pattern of a key's scope, which the key is allowed.

SubmissionBody.description:
The submission in the `analysis` field. This is `ace_core::submit::Submission` as the document shows
it, and `tests/api.rs` checks that the two take the same fields.

analysis_mode.description: The root's analysis mode, such as `email` or `correlation`; the default mode when left out.

event_time.description: When the event happened; the time of the submission when left out.

file_yara_meta.description:
`yara_meta` tags for submitted files, by the file's path in the alert, such as
`{"invoice.zip": ["type=email.attachment"]}`.

SubmitForm.description: The form, as the document shows it.

file.description: Each file, repeated; its file name is its path in the alert.

exclude_modules.description: Modules that must not analyze it.

type.description: An observable type, such as `fqdn` or `ipv4`.

UserBody.description: A user. Never their password or its hash.

api_keys.description: How many API keys they own.

groups.description: Their groups, whose grants they hold too.

ZipBody.description: A download's bytes, as the document shows them.

api_key.description: An API key, `ace4k_...`, shown once when it was made.

session.name: ace4_session
session.description: A GUI session's cookie, `__Host-ace4_session` under TLS. A request that could change something must also come from ACE's own pages.

tags.name: users
